description: This file defines the AgentWorkspace enum which manages the setup, configuration, and filesystem interactions for an agent workspace, including templates, safety checks, and file management functions.

classes.name: AgentWorkspace.BootstrapSafety
classes.description: Represents the safety status of the workspace, indicating whether it is safe or blocked with a reason.

methods.name: displayPath
methods.description: Returns a human-readable path for the given URL, replacing the home directory with '~' when applicable.

methods.name: resolveWorkspaceURL
methods.description: Resolves and returns a URL from user input, expanding tilde and defaulting if input is empty.

methods.name: agentsURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the agents file within the workspace.

methods.name: workspaceEntries
methods.description: Returns non-ignored entries in the workspace directory.

methods.name: isWorkspaceEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the workspace directory is empty.

methods.name: isTemplateOnlyWorkspace
methods.description: Determines if the workspace contains only template files.

methods.name: bootstrapSafety
methods.description: Evaluates the safety status of the workspace based on its contents and configuration.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the workspace by creating necessary files and directories, seeding templates if applicable.

methods.name: needsBootstrap
methods.description: Checks if the workspace requires bootstrap setup.

methods.name: hasIdentity
methods.description: Checks whether the identity file has been populated with values.

methods.name: identityLinesHaveValues
methods.description: Analyzes the contents of IDENTITY.md to see if any lines contain actual values.

methods.name: defaultTemplate
methods.description: Provides a default content for the AGENTS.md template.

methods.name: defaultSoulTemplate
methods.description: Provides a default content for the SOUL.md template.

methods.name: defaultIdentityTemplate
methods.description: Provides a default content for the IDENTITY.md template.

methods.name: defaultUserTemplate
methods.description: Provides a default content for the USER.md template.

methods.name: defaultBootstrapTemplate
methods.description: Provides a default content for the BOOTSTRAP.md template.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Attempts to load a specific template file from various locations, returning a fallback if none are found.

methods.name: templateURLs
methods.description: Constructs a list of potential URLs where a template file might be located.

methods.name: devTemplateURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL to a development version of a template file.

methods.name: stripFrontMatter
methods.description: Removes front matter from a template string if present.
